response.query: What sensitivity analyses and alternative estimators (e.g., three-source, hierarchical/Bayesian) will you run if Chapman estimator assumptions are violated?
response.answer: If Chapman estimator assumptions are violated, consider three-source and hierarchical/Bayesian estimators for sensitivity analyses. These alternatives provide robust estimates under different data conditions.

results.title: [PDF] The Influence of e-Servicescape on Consumer Emotions and Attitudes
results.content: Chieko Minami Laboratory Business Administration 174B411B Inggang Perwangsa Nuralam ii ABSTRACT The purpose of this study is to examine the relationship between e-servicescape, emotions, and attitudes on music websites based on Environmental Psychology theory and the Stimulus-Organism-Response framework. We designed this study in a series of different tests to obtain a complete and holistic picture of the e-Servicescape relationship (Ambient; Spatial Layout and Functionality; Signs, Symbols, and Artifacts, Financial Security, and Interactivity), Emotions (Pleasure and Arousal), and Attitudes; including manipulation checks, factorial experiment with analysis of variance (ANOVA) test, quasi experiment with multigroup analysis (MGA) test, and structural equation modeling (SEM) test. Keywords: e-Servicescape, Pleasure, Arousal, Attitudes, Environmental Psychology, the S-O-R framework.
